title: Avoid layout shift when toggling button spinners and localized labels
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: In multiple recent regressions users observed that when a button switches from its label to a spinner (or adds a right-aligned spinner), the width of the button can change. This causes layout shift, content reflow, and awkward truncation for localized labels (Japanese/German longer strings). Compound icon buttons (icon + label + caret) are particularly fragile. Scope: propose a resilient CSS/token-driven solution, update component implementation guidance, add visual/interaction tests across locales and high-contrast themes, and coordinate with Engineering for a non-breaking rollout.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Button components reserve stable width or collapse only within defined truncation rules when entering loading state. 2) Localized labels do not overflow their container or cause page reflow in supported locales (en, ja, de, fr, es, ru). 3) Icon-only and compound icon buttons maintain consistent hit target and visual alignment when spinner is introduced. 4) Implementation follows accessibility guidance (aria-live, role updates) and passes reduced-motion/high-contrast QA. 5) Token changes documented and backward-compatible with an opt-in migration path.
design_notes:
- Use a zero-width placeholder element that mirrors the spinner's size to reserve inline space when spinner is hidden.
- Introduce a spacing token: spacing.button.spinner-gap that defines gap between icon/label/spinner and is testable across themes.
- Truncation rules: primary labels truncate with ellipsis after a configurable max-chars per breakpoint; secondary/CTA buttons prefer fixed min-width variant for critical actions.
- For localized text, prefer min-width variants for destructive/primary buttons to avoid critical label loss.
- Introduce 'spinner-affine' token to control whether spinner overlays content or takes inline space (default: inline reserve).
decisions:
- Default behavior: reserve inline space for spinner to avoid layout shift. Teams may opt into overlay behavior where space is constrained (e.g., mobile compact variant).
- Accessibility: spinner changes announced with aria-live='polite' and button has aria-busy='true' when loading. We will not auto-focus when loading to avoid context shifts.
- Token migration: keep old spacing tokens and introduce aliases that map to new spinner-gap token; deprecation scheduled for 2026-Q1.
tradeoffs:
- Reserving inline space increases visual whitespace on idle buttons, potentially affecting tight layouts. We mitigate with a min-width variant and compact mode.
- Overlay spinner reduces layout shift but can obscure label briefly and complicates text-readers; chosen as opt-in.
- Enforcing min-width for localized labels increases chance of wrapping on very small mobile screens; recommend using shorter copy for mobile or use icon-only variant.
engineering_todos:
- ENG PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/8462 (WIP) to add spinner placeholder and spinner-affine token.
- Add unit and visual regression tests for en/ja/de locales: Percy snapshots + Cypress interaction tests.
- Update React Button component props: loadingMode: 'reserve' | 'overlay' and expose spinnerGap token.
- Add migration guide in docs: Design Tokens > Buttons > Spinner spacing.
qa_notes:
- Test matrix: locales [en, ja, de, fr, es, ru], themes [light, dark, high-contrast], reduced-motion on/off, viewport widths [320, 375, 768, 1024], RTL toggle.
- Verify keyboard and screen reader behavior when toggling loading: aria-busy updates, polite live region content not noisy.
- Confirm no layout shift greater than 5px for primary buttons on toggle.
- Visual snapshots for overlay vs reserve modes.
status_updates: 2025-02-14: Problem triaged after design QA flagged two regressions reported via Support and internal bug tracker. Linked incident notes from #design-ux channel.
2025-02-20: Prototype implemented in Figma with both reserve and overlay variants. Reviewed with Engineering (Jonah, Priya). Decision to default to reserve variant for stability.
2025-02-27: ENG PR opened (WIP). Added spinnerGap token and API for loadingMode. Need follow-up on token naming and migration plan.
2025-03-04: Accessibility review scheduled. Initial accessibility notes added; awaiting SR team sign-off. QA to write Percy tests after PR is ready.
comments: Maya Chen (design): Please check truncated examples for Japanese — lengthiest labels hit min-width. Recommend min-width variant for primary CTA.
Jonah Patel (eng): Adding prop-based approach so customers can opt into overlay behavior. Will keep reserve as default to reduce regressions.
Priya Singh (a11y): Confirming aria-busy + live region approach is acceptable; will verify SR team guidelines and add recommended screen-reader phrasing.
